the new measures of performance of the prediction models are more useful than the AUC in assessing the added predictive ability and the clinical usefulness of the newer biomarkers and the newer risk formulations.
the AUC should not be used as the only criterion for assessing and comparing the performance of new biomarkers and new prediction models.

the AUC alone may not be sufficient to fully characterize the performance of a new risk model, and other measures, such as the integrated sensitivity and specificity (ISS), should also be considered.
